items.titleZh: BBC可能失去F1广播权，talkSPORT考虑竞标
items.summaryZh: talkSPORT考虑竞标英国F1广播权，可能结束BBC长期垄断。

media.altZh: BBC可能失去F1广播权，talkSPORT考虑竞标 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: BBC could lose F1 radio rights after 32 years as rival broadcaster considers bid
detailZh: BBC可能将在32年后失去一级方程式的广播权，因为竞争对手正在考虑投标
talkSPORT正在探索对一级方程式英国广播权的潜在投标，这给BBC长期以来的报道带来了压力
费尔南多·阿隆索、阿斯顿·马丁赛车、伊萨克·哈吉亚、红牛车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
talkSPORT正在考虑竞标英国一级方程式赛车的广播权，这可能会结束BBC在该国作为赛车广播主场的长期统治。
该电台负责人Liam Fisher在接受《每日电讯报》采访时表示，一级方程式赛车适合talkSPORT的听众，如Crash.net报道。自1994年以来，BBC一直在广播一级方程式赛车，因此这可能对英国的一级方程式车迷如何跟上他们最喜欢的车手产生重大变化。
"这是一套非常棒的权益。如果我不积极探索是否有机会，我就没有在做好我的工作," Fisher说。
"我们认为观众与talkSPORT的观众非常契合。我们认为我们有很好的机会为它提供真正的放大效果。"
talkSPORT最著名的节目是深度足球报道，但这位英国人表示，该电台希望通过扩大组织的覆盖范围进入新的细分市场来吸引新的听众。
"足球仍然是我们的主食，但我们确实在基本理解的基础上寻求扩展，即使足球是你的第一、第二和第三运动，你很可能还对其他事物感兴趣，"他说。
"因此，我们的策略是挑选出我们认为有潜在观众的事件，这些事件与我们提供的内容相得益彰。"
该电台今年已经进入了赛车运动。5月份，它获得了夏季六场MotoGP赛事的转播权，由TNT Sports的解说团队在talkSPORT2上播出。
BBC的当前合同即将到期
BBC与一级方程式的当前合同从2025年到2027年给予Radio 5 Live、5 Sports Extra和BBC Sounds在英国的独家音频版权。
其报道团队包括1996年世界冠军达蒙·希尔、一级方程式车手山姆·伯德、前W系列车手爱丽丝·鲍威尔和前F1机械师马克·普里斯特利。
据《每日电讯报》报道，BBC目前正在尝试削减成本，这样的变化并不令人意外。尤其是在它最近还取消了赛船赛和英联邦运动会田径比赛之后。
detailEn: BBC could lose F1 radio rights after 32 years as rival broadcaster considers bid
talkSPORT is exploring a potential bid for Formula 1's UK radio rights, putting the BBC's long-running coverage under pressure
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
talkSPORT is considering a bid for the UK radio rights to Formula 1, which could end the BBC's long run as the sport's home on radio in the country.

The station's head, Liam Fisher, told The Telegraph that F1 would suit talkSPORT's listeners, as reported by Crash.net. The BBC has broadcast F1 on radio since 1994, so this could be a massive change to how UK-based F1 fans keep up with their favourite drivers.
"It's another brilliant set of rights. I wouldn't be doing my job if I wasn't actively exploring whether there's an opportunity," Fisher said.
"We think the audience goes quite well with the talkSPORT audience. We think there's an opportunity for us to deliver really good amplification for it as well."
talkSPORT is best known for its in-depth football coverage, but the Briton said the station wants to reach new listeners by extending the organisation's reach into new niches.

"Football still is our bread and butter, but we've definitely looked to extend it on the basic understanding that, even if football is your first, second, and third sport, you are probably into something else as well," he said.
"So our strategy has been to pick off the events where we believe there is an audience potential that sits well with what we're providing."
The station has already moved into motorsport this year. In May it secured the rights to six MotoGP races over the summer, broadcast on talkSPORT2 with the TNT Sports' commentary team.
The BBC's current deal is coming to an end
The BBC's current deal with F1 gives Radio 5 Live, 5 Sports Extra and BBC Sounds exclusive UK audio rights from 2025 to 2027.
Its coverage team includes 1996 world champion Damon Hill, Formula E driver Sam Bird, former W Series driver Alice Powell and ex-F1 mechanic Marc Priestley.

With The Telegraph reporting that the BBC is currently trying to cut costs, this change wouldn't come as such a surprise. Especially after it also recently dropped the Boat Race and the Commonwealth Games athletics.
keyPointsEn: BBC has been broadcasting F1 since 1994

items.titleZh: 阿隆索与阿斯顿·马丁近期怪象背后的技术谜团
items.summaryZh: The Race分析阿斯顿·马丁-本田近期成绩起伏中阿隆索遭遇的奇怪技术故障与退赛，并提到他在巴库用上了本田先给斯特罗尔在马德里使用的秘密ADUO 2涡轮升级。

media.altZh: 阿隆索与阿斯顿·马丁近期怪象背后的技术谜团 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: The strange Alonso subplot to Aston Martin's weird recent run
items.summaryEn: The Race examines the strange technical problems and retirements Fernando Alonso has suffered amid Aston Martin-Honda's fluctuating form, and notes that in Baku he got the secret ADUO 2 turbocharger upgrade Honda first fitted to Lance Stroll's car in Madrid.
detailZh: 阿斯顿·马丁-本田近期的状态起伏不定，仿佛在模仿我们预期在2026年F1中看到的比赛风格，而其明星车手费尔南多·阿隆索身上还发生了一些更奇怪的事情。
我说的不是他与车队旷日持久、最近当然已经结束的合同谈判，而更多是他在本赛季可以说是围场里最麻烦的赛车上遇到的奇怪技术故障和退赛。
在巴库，阿隆索拿到了本田秘密的ADUO 2涡轮增压器升级，该升级此前先装在了兰斯·斯特罗尔于马德里驾驶的赛车上。
自本田在赞德沃特带来赛季中期的ADUO 1引擎升级以来，本田一直在努力改善驾驶性和涡轮迟滞，本田知道巴库将是检验这些特性的重要测试。
马克·休斯：这些惊人的数据暗示阿斯顿·马丁具备争夺杆位的潜力
减少涡轮迟滞不仅能改善发动机的整体驾驶性，还有助于防止MGU-K去填补因涡轮迟滞造成的发动机扭矩需求缺口，即电机本质上是用电池提供的电力来替代缺失的内燃机扭矩输出。
大量短促、缓慢的弯角以及困难且关键的牵引力区域，是检验你的赛车和发动机能否以正确方式出弯加速的良好测试。
在阿塞拜疆，更新后的阿斯顿·马丁——得益于车尾一些更轻的部件，比以往任何时候都更接近重量限制，再加上那台（我们认为）配备更小涡轮的规格2本田发动机——一直到城堡路段（含）都表现良好。
但随后它在第三赛段损失了大量圈速，这表明MGU-K在单圈早期做了太多那种“填补”（infilling），从而在之后造成了能量部署问题。
这是这辆车排位赛表现中的一个趋势，至少可以追溯到7月底在匈牙利B版赛车首次亮相时。单圈内圈速有明显退化，尤其是在该圈接近尾声时，几乎无论赛道如何都是如此。
在马来西亚甚至也是如此——那显然是这辆车本赛季的最佳表现——那里粗糙的赛道表面和过热的轮胎剥夺了所有赛车的抓地力，并人为地延长了慢弯和松油时段的长度与持续时间，而阿斯顿·马丁在这些地方相对更有竞争力。
回到巴库，阿隆索在阿塞拜疆大奖赛跑了20圈后退赛，显然是因为引擎问题。
“我没有看到任何警报，”他事后说道。“但我在直道上开始损失很多时间。你知道，大概1.5秒，所以肯定有问题。”
但赛后，本田检查了引擎，没有发现任何问题。
“目前引擎没有问题，我们在数据上没有发现任何异常，”本田首席赛道工程师折原慎太郎在那场比赛后说道。
“所以我们需要仔细检查引擎动力以及能量管理，也许还有GPS轨迹。”
随后，The Race 在下一站雪邦站询问本田，工厂的分析是否发现了任何问题，但本田再次表示没有发现任何异常。
“我们做了维护，并对引擎进行了物理检查，”折原说道。“但数据上仍然没有任何引擎问题的迹象。”
类似的事情也发生在新加坡。在又一次止步于第一节排位赛后，阿隆索声称他的赛车涡轮增压器“坏了”。因此，车队选择让他从维修区起步并换上全新部件，但本田再次未能在引擎上找到除阿隆索的诊断之外的任何涡轮问题证据。
本田在这里的脱困之道，是将车手——在此即阿隆索——描述为赛车内的“最佳传感器”，尤其当这个传感器拥有阿隆索那种不可思议的感知力和经验时更是如此。
同样属实的是，车手有时能察觉到工程师最初未能发现的问题——前威廉姆斯技术总监帕特里克·海德提供了一个很好的例子，他在2005年表示，车队新签下的尼克·海德菲尔德发现了宝马发动机管理系统的问题，而车队“已经带着这个问题两年了，却没有人指出来”。
那是20多年前的事了，在此期间F1数据采集的保真度已大幅提升，但这很好地说明了海德菲尔德作为车手特有的敏感度如何揭示了一个问题，而胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚或拉尔夫·舒马赫——两人在客观上都比海德菲尔德当时更成功——要么自己从未感觉到，要么没有受到足够严重的影响，以至于觉得有必要在汇报中提出。
阿隆索在座舱内作为精准的工程参考享有极高声誉，因此如果他察觉到问题，通常你会预期阿隆索感觉到的任何异常最终都会出现在本田的数据中。
在阿隆索的案例中，这（还）没有发生，而他在阿塞拜疆与通常较慢的凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯缠斗时愤怒的车队无线电，清楚地表明他对那个周末本田发动机的整体性能并不满意。
阿斯顿·马丁车队现场负责人（兼前车队领队）迈克·克拉克随后提出，也许是跟随凯迪拉克时产生的尾流效应，再加上超车模式激活后带来的额外动力提升，可能让阿隆索感觉他的本田引擎出了问题。
这也有可能——阿隆索感觉到了一个实际上并不存在的问题。
也许永远没人能确定，但在本田从其遥测数据中发现尚未察觉的异常之前，所有迹象都指向阿隆索基本上是在巴库站放弃比赛、提前收工。
而且，考虑到车队在2026年的整体糟糕表现，也许没人能怪他！
detailEn: While Aston Martin-Honda's recent form has yo-yo'd, mimicking the style of racing we've come to expect in Formula 1 in 2026, there's been some even stranger things going on with its star driver Fernando Alonso.

I'm not talking about his protracted contract negotiations with the team, recently concluded of course, but more some of the strange technical problems and retirements he's had with what, to be fair, has been the most troublesome car on the grid this season.
In Baku, Alonso got his hands on the secret ADUO 2 turbocharger upgrade Honda fitted first to Lance Stroll's car in Madrid.
Honda's been trying to improve driveability and turbo lag since it brought its mid-season ADUO 1 engine upgrade to Zandvoort, and Honda knew Baku would be an important test for those characteristics.
Mark Hughes: The extraordinary figures hinting at Aston Martin's pole potential

Reduced turbo lag not only improves the overall driveability of the engine, it also helps prevent the MGU-K filling in the engine torque demand gaps created by that lag, whereby the motor essentially replaces missing internal combustion torque delivery with electrical power from the battery.
Lots of short, slow turns with difficult and crucial traction zones are a good test of whether your car and engine are punching off the corners in the right way.

In Azerbaijan, the updated Aston Martin - closer than ever to the weight limit thanks to some lighter components at the rear of the car, plus that spec-2 Honda engine with its (we think) smaller turbo - was working well up to and including the castle section.
But then it was haemorrhaging laptime through sector three, suggesting the MGU-K was doing too much of that 'infilling' early in the lap and then creating energy deployment problems later on.

This is a trend in the car's qualifying performances going back at least as far as the debut of the B-spec car in Hungary, in late July. There is a noticeable degradation in laptime over a single lap, particularly towards the end of that lap, almost regardless of the circuit.

This was even the case in Malaysia - easily that car's best performance of the season - where the rough track surface and overheating tyres robbed all the cars of grip and artificially extended the length and duration of the slow corners and off-throttle moments where the Aston Martin is relatively more competitive.
Returning to Baku, there Alonso retired from the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after 20 laps, apparently with an engine problem.
"I didn't see any alarm," he said afterwards. "But I started losing a lot on the straight. You know, like 1.5 seconds, so something wrong."
But after the race, Honda checked the engine and could find nothing wrong.
"At the moment the engine is OK, we don't find any issue on the data," said Honda chief trackside engineer Shintaro Orihara after that race.
"So we need to check carefully on the engine power and also energy management and also maybe GPS trace."
The Race then asked Honda at the next event in Sepang whether analysis at the factory had revealed any issue, but again Honda said it found nothing amiss.
"We did maintenance and we checked the engine physically," said Orihara. "But still on the data there is no indication of the engine problem."

Something similar happened in Singapore. After yet another Q1 exit, Alonso claimed his car's turbocharger was "broken". The team thus elected to start him from the pitlane with fresh components, but once again Honda could find no evidence of a turbo problem on the engine, beyond Alonso's diagnosis.

Honda's get out of jail card here has been to describe the driver - in this case Alonso - as "the best sensor" inside the car, especially so when that sensor has Alonso's incredible level of feel and experience.

It's also true that drivers sometimes detect problems that aren't initially picked up by engineers - there's a good example given by former Williams technical director Patrick Head, who back in 2005 said its new signing Nick Heidfeld had detected problems with the BMW engine's management system that the team had been "carrying for two years without anyone pointing it out".

That was more than 20 years ago, and the fidelity of data capture in F1 has improved vastly in that time, but it's a good example of how Heidfeld's particular sensitivity as a driver uncovered something problematic that Juan Pablo Montoya or Ralf Schumacher - both objectively more successful F1 drivers then Heidfeld was - either never felt themselves, or were not so unduly affected by to feel the need to raise in debriefs.

Alonso has an incredible reputation for being an accurate engineering reference inside the cockpit, and so if he's detecting an issue you would ordinarily expect whatever Alonso has felt going wrong to show up in Honda's data eventually.

That has't happened (yet) in Alonso's case, and his furious team radio while battling the usually slower Cadillac of Valtteri Bottas in Azerbaijan gave a clear indication he was less than happy with his Honda engine's overall performance that weekend.

Aston Martin trackside chief (and former team principal) Mike Krack later suggested perhaps the tow effect from following the Cadillac, combined with having the extra boost available from overtake mode being active, might have caused Alonso to feel as though there was a problem with his Honda engine.
That could also be possible - that Alonso has felt a problem that doesn't actually present itself in reality.

Perhaps no one will ever know for sure but, until Honda finds something it's yet to spot in its telemetry, all the signs point to Alonso basically throwing in the towel and taking an early bath in Baku.
And, given the team's woeful overall performance in 2026, maybe no one could blame him!
keyPointsZh: 本田自赞德沃特带来赛季中期ADUO 1引擎升级后，一直在改善驾驶性与涡轮迟滞，并认为巴库是检验这些特性的重要测试。
涡轮迟滞减小不仅改善引擎整体驾驶性，也有助于避免MGU-K用电池电能填补内燃机扭矩输出缺口。
keyPointsEn: Since bringing its mid-season ADUO 1 engine upgrade to Zandvoort, Honda has been working on driveability and turbo lag, and saw Baku as an important test of those characteristics.
Reduced turbo lag not only improves overall engine driveability but also helps prevent the MGU-K from filling the internal combustion torque gaps with battery power.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘回应前F1车手对2026年规则的批评
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手维斯塔潘就前车手对他所受批评发表看法，认为这种负面情绪源于专家们对2026年规则的误解。

media.altZh: 维斯塔潘回应前F1车手对2026年规则的批评 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen hits back at ex-F1 drivers over criticism of 2026 regulations
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘就2026年规则的批评回应前F1车手
马克斯·维斯塔潘指责一些前F1车手在批评锦标赛新规则之前未能理解规则
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯、马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队
对于红牛车迷来说。关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析。
红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘就他收到的前车手的批评发表了看法，这位四次世界冠军认为这种负面情绪源于专家们不理解2026年的规定。
在新加坡大奖赛周末接受《De Telegraaf》采访时，在被展示1996年世界冠军达蒙·希尔最近的评论后，这位荷兰人表达了他对为什么在他看来前车手在接受采访时会给出“非常奇怪的答案”的看法。
“你知道很多前车手的问题在哪里吗？”维斯塔潘说，“他们根本不研究新的规定。所以他们不知道发动机是如何运行的，以及它是如何工作的。然后他们在电视上被问到这些问题，有时就会给出非常奇怪的答案。”
他迅速补充说，这“并不适用于所有人，但确实适用于其中的一些人。”
费尔南多·阿隆索和兰多·诺里斯都支持他对规则的看法，但维斯塔潘表示他并不在寻找盟友。相反，他只是就今年到目前为止他所看到的情况发表了意见。
“我只是说出我的想法，在我眼中什么是不对的，以及什么可以改进，”他继续说。 “有时我会因为这一点受到某些人的批评，或者他们说他们不理解我的意思。但最终，事情的好坏会变得清楚。”
维斯塔潘、红牛车队、乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯
维斯塔潘是本赛季新规则最响亮的批评者之一。这一变化带来了新的动力单元，对电能的依赖性更大。虽然他承认考虑过从F1退役，但他最终在上个月只延长了与米尔顿凯恩斯车队的合同至2030年。
这真是时候，因为这位车手刚刚在马来西亚和新加坡连续赢得胜利。他在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为221分，仅比法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿少8分。
美国大奖赛将于10月23日至25日举行。
detailEn: Max Verstappen hits back at ex-F1 drivers over criticism of 2026 regulations
Max Verstappen has accused some former Formula 1 drivers of failing to understand the championship's new regulations before offering criticism
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull driver Max Verstappen has spoken out on the criticism he has received from former drivers, with the four-time champion believing this negativity stems from the pundits not understanding the 2026 regulations.

Talking with De Telegraaf during the Singapore Grand Prix weekend, after being shown recent comments from 1996 world champion Damon Hill, the Dutchman gave his opinion on why, in his eyes, former drivers can give “very strange answers” when they are being interviewed.

“Do you know what the problem is with a lot of ex-drivers?” Verstappen said. “They don’t study the new regulations at all. So they don’t know exactly how the engine runs and exactly how it works. Then they get asked about it on television, and sometimes very strange answers come out.”
He was quick to add that it “doesn’t apply to everyone, but it does apply to a number of them”.

Fernando Alonso and Lando Norris have both backed his opinions on the regulations, but Verstappen said he isn’t looking for allies. Instead, he was simply giving his opinion on what he’d seen so far this year.

“I just say what I think, what is wrong in my eyes and what could be improved,” he continued. “Sometimes I get criticised for that by certain people, or they say they don’t understand what I mean. But in the end, it will become clear whether something is good or bad.”
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

Verstappen has been one of the loudest critics of the new regulations starting this season. The change brought new power units with a much larger reliance on electrical power. While he admitted considering retirement from F1, he eventually extended his contract with the Milton Keynes outfit until 2030 only two months ago .

And this was well timed, as the driver has just scored back-to-back wins in Malaysia and Singapore. He sits fourth in the drivers’ standings with 221 points, just eight behind Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton.
The United States Grand Prix takes place from 23 to 25 October.

items.originalTitle: How Geri Halliwell helped Christian Horner deal with fan hate
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner has explained how his wife Geri Halliwell helped him overcome the hostility that came with his rise in fame due to the Formula 1 documentary series Drive to Survive.
detailZh: 杰瑞·哈利维尔如何帮克里斯蒂安·霍纳应对车迷敌意
这位前辣妹组合成员是霍纳的妻子，霍纳曾于2025年在一场F1赛季发布活动上被观众嘘声对待
杰瑞·霍纳与红牛车队领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳
克里斯蒂安·霍纳讲述了妻子、名人杰瑞·哈利维尔如何帮助他克服因F1纪录片《极速求生》带来的名气上升而遭遇的敌意。
自2015年以来，霍纳一直与前辣妹组合成员哈莉韦尔结婚，她于1994年22岁时加入了这个举世闻名的流行乐队，这意味着她早年就已成名。
对霍纳而言，成名要晚得多，很大程度上归功于2019年在Netflix上线的《极速求生》，这导致F1的受欢迎程度飙升，并向新的观众群体敞开了大门。
因此，更多人开始认识这位前红牛车队负责人，他扮演了“哑剧反派”的角色——尤其是在他与梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫的激烈竞争中。
两人花了十年时间争夺F1冠军，由于他们受到的关注增加，尤其是霍纳，仇恨和批评自然也随之增加。
霍纳对《Autosport》表示：“我在赛车运动中和媒体打交道的方式是共存，你需要接触车手和车队，双方都有各自的角色要履行。”
观看：克里斯蒂安·霍纳谈托托、2021年阿布扎比以及红牛之后的生活。
“双方都需要彼此。随着《极速求生》的出现，车队领队突然成了名人，杰里和她经历过的——你得记住，她曾是史上最伟大女子乐队的一员。
“所以她在很小年纪就见识到的名气是天文数字级别的，那还是在互联网出现之前、报纸能写出非常恶毒内容的时代。”
“她对这一切变得非常麻木，甚至到了她说‘我根本不看’的地步。她极少会去读一篇文章，所以对我来说，她真是了不起。
“只要你自己内心快乐，就别管……每个人都会有看法，有人可能喜欢，有人可能不喜欢，但只要你忠于自己就好。
“我永远忘不了她对我说：‘你必须记住的是，别人拍你后背夸你，离踹你屁股只有六英寸！’
“所以他们会前一分钟爱你，下一分钟就对你恶语相向。所以她一直是一股力量，很有能力，而且她永远只看到别人身上的好。”
其中一个特别的时刻发生在F1 75 Live活动上，这是2025年在伦敦O2体育馆举办的新赛季发布活动，各车队在活动上展示了他们新赛季的新形象。
但当霍纳伴随着滚石乐队的《Start Me Up》登台时，歌曲被观众的嘘声淹没，这对这位英国人来说显然是一个令人不适的时刻。
“你有什么选择？你要么缩进壳里走下舞台，要么就硬着头皮面对，”霍纳补充道，他在五个月后被免职。
“我从来不是那种会退缩的人，每个人都有权发表自己的看法。你不可能成为所有人喜欢的那杯茶，不可能成为所有人的宠儿。
“显然我们得到的反应并不算最友好，但随后又有人来找你自拍，迫不及待地想和你合影。
“所以这有点矛盾。这几乎让人挺困惑的，‘好吧，如果你不喜欢我，为什么还要找我拍照？’
“当我重新坐下时，其实是Geri对我说，‘记住，他们只有在乎才会嘘你，如果他们不在乎，就什么都不会说’。所以你能得到的最糟糕的反应是什么都没有！”
detailEn: How Geri Halliwell helped Christian Horner deal with fan hate
The former Spice Girl is married to Horner, who was once booed on stage at an F1 season launch event in 2025
Geri Horner with Christian Horner, Team Principal, Red Bull Racing
Christian Horner has explained how his celebrity wife Geri Halliwell helped him overcome the hate that came with his rise in fame thanks to Formula 1 drama Drive to Survive.
Since 2015 Horner has been married to former Spice Girl Halliwell, who joined the world-famous pop band in 1994 at the age of 22, meaning she had fame from early on in her life.
For Horner it came much later and largely due to Drive to Survive launching on Netflix in 2019, which consequently caused F1’s popularity to spike and open it up to a new audience.
So more individuals became aware of the former Red Bull boss, who played into the ‘pantomime villain’ role - particularly during his heated rivalry with Mercedes counterpart Toto Wolff.
Both individuals spent a decade vying for the F1 title and due to the increased spotlight on them, particularly Horner, the hate and criticism naturally increased.
“The way I worked with the media in motorsport was that we co-existed and you needed access to the drivers and the team and both had a role to fulfil,” Horner told Autosport.
Watch: Christian Horner on Toto, Abu Dhabi 2021 and Life After Red Bull.

“Both needed each other. With the advent of Drive to Survive, suddenly team principals [were] becoming personalities, Geri and her experience, you have to remember that she was part of the biggest girl band of all time.
“So the fame that she saw at a very young age was astronomical in a time before the internet and when papers could write very nasty things.
“She became very hardened to it and to the point that she says, ‘I don't look at it’. She very rarely will read an article and so for me, she was incredibly good.
“As long as you're happy in yourself, ignore what…everybody's going to have an opinion and somebody might like, somebody might not like, but just be true to yourself.
“I never forget she told me, ‘What you have to remember is a pat on the back is six inches from a kick up the arse!
“So they'll love you one minute, you'll get shit the next minute. So she has been a force and has an ability and she only ever sees the good in people.”
One particular moment came during F1 75 Live, which was a season launch event held at the O2 London in 2025, where teams unveiled their new looks for the year ahead.
But when Horner entered the stage to Rolling Stones hit Start Me Up, the song was drowned out by boos from the crowd in a clearly uncomfortable moment for the Briton.
“What are your choices? You either shrink into a shell and walk off the stage or you front it out,” added Horner, who was removed from his position five months later.
“I've never been one to shy away and everybody is entitled to have their opinion. You can't be everybody's cup of tea, everybody's darling.
“Obviously we didn't get the friendliest of reactions, but then you've got people asking for selfies and desperate to get pictures with you.
“So it's kind of a contrast. It was almost quite confusing, ‘Well, if you don't like me, why are you asking for a picture?’
“When I sat back down it was actually Geri that said to me, ‘just remember they only boo when they care, if they don't care they don't say anything’. So the worst reaction you can have is nothing!”

哈利维尔于1994年22岁时加入辣妹组合，早年便成名。

items.titleZh: 法拉利将在美国大奖赛推出2026赛季最大升级
items.summaryZh: 法拉利计划在美国大奖赛推出2026赛季第四套、也是规模最大的空气动力学升级包，涉及底板、侧箱和上部车身。

media.altZh: 法拉利将在美国大奖赛推出2026赛季最大升级 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: What Ferrari's changing with its biggest F1 upgrade of 2026
items.summaryEn: Ferrari is set to introduce its fourth and largest aerodynamic upgrade package of the 2026 season at the United States Grand Prix, covering the floor, sidepods and upper bodywork.
detailZh: 法拉利正准备在美国大奖赛推出其2026年F1赛季的第四套、也是最重要的一套空气动力学升级包。
奥斯汀的这套升级是SF-26计划中最后一次如此规模的开发包，而马拉内罗的注意力如今已基本转向明年赛车的开发——由于规则限制和根本性的空气动力学选择，那辆车将完全不同。
美洲赛道的更新将涉及赛车多个区域，包括对底板、侧箱和上部车身的修改。
据我们的信息，与一些主要竞争对手不同，法拉利决定不彻底改变其侧箱的空气动力学概念。
迈凯伦和梅赛德斯，尤其是后者，最近通过最新升级对其概念进行了重大改变，大幅修改了侧箱的形状以及气流沿侧箱流动的方式。两支车队似乎都没有立即在赛道上实现其在风洞和CFD模拟中看到的效果。
另一方面，法拉利更倾向于与SF-26当前架构保持更大的连续性。
据了解，法拉利主要致力于优化其现有解决方案，而没有对车身进行根本性改变。据信主要目标是降低阻力，因为SF-26在这方面仍有些吃力。（法拉利动力较弱的引擎对此也没有帮助。）
因此，车队更倾向于采用侵入性较小的解决方案，力求最大化当前设计的潜力，同时权衡性能提升与实现这些提升所需的资源。
新车身将伴随冷却百叶窗的修改，使热空气排出适应新的侧箱几何形状。进一步的冷却配置计划在接下来的墨西哥大奖赛上使用，届时法拉利预计将引入更大的开口，以应对高海拔带来的特别严苛条件。
这并不意味着法拉利没有考虑过更激进的替代方案。
在开发过程中，风洞中进行了大量迭代，探索不同的几何形状和车身概念，同时也考虑到了2027年项目的空气动力学选择。
在马拉内罗本赛季分析的解决方案中，包括红牛引入的侧箱设计，其特点是对有关底板车身支撑件的法规做出了有趣的解读。
在小红牛22上，以及从巴库站起在奥迪赛车上，连接底板与车身结构的支撑件也被用于空气动力学目的。通过支撑件与侧箱表面之间的圆角过渡，红牛成功塑造出特别激进的几何形状，因为现行规则允许20毫米的圆角半径。这有助于重现所谓的“水滑梯”通道，即引导气流流向赛车尾部的通道。
这一方案让一个主要承担结构功能的部件也能影响车身的形状和空气动力学表现。
法拉利仔细研究并评估了这一概念，但决定不将很大一部分资源投入到对SF-26侧箱如此大幅度的改造上。
这一决定主要是研发优先级的问题。
对侧箱理念进行大幅改动，本需要与空气动力学平台的其他部分（尤其是底板）进行整合工作，而且在剩余不多的比赛中无法确定能获得足够显著的优势。
因此，在马拉内罗，偏好是将精力集中在另一个仍被认为最具性能潜力的领域：底板。
至于新底板，改动不会局限于单一区域，而是将涉及对整个系统更广泛的修订，从前部一直到扩散器。
继续在这一部件上投入的决定，也与在赞德沃特引入的上一套套件所取得的结果有关。
这一开发成果被带到荷兰，是因为法拉利未能在短期内找到特别显著的改进机会，促使车队继续研究底板几何形状，以寻求专门为奥斯汀站带来更大幅度的提升。
SF-26在整个赛季中展现出了良好的基础设计，但工程师们仍在继续寻求提升赛车底部所产生的性能。
奥斯汀的新底板不仅旨在增加下压力，还旨在解决空气动力学平衡问题——目前平衡仍过于偏向前部——并拓宽工作窗口，正如红牛在一定程度上做到的那样。
美国大奖赛将是法拉利推出如此重要空气动力学套件的最后一场比赛。奥斯汀站之后，SF-26的开发将主要限于针对特定赛道的适配。
法拉利还利用多次风洞迭代探索了2027年的不同设计方向，届时新车将采用与SF-26相比有显著不同的空气动力学方案。
尽管如此，未来的法拉利仍将与当前项目保留一些延续性元素，尤其是在底盘方面——底盘一直是2026年赛车最令人信服的部分之一，同时2027年动力单元的工作也在并行推进。
奥斯汀还将提供一个机会，用来验证开发工具所得结果与赛车在赛道上的表现之间的相关性。
detailEn: Ferrari is preparing to introduce what will be its fourth and most significant aerodynamic upgrade package of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the United States Grand Prix.

The Austin upgrade is the final development package of this scale planned for the SF-26, while attention at Maranello has now largely shifted towards the development of next year's car, which will be completely different, both due to regulatory restrictions and fundamental aerodynamic choices.
The updates at the Circuit of the Americas will affect several areas of the car, with modifications to the floor, sidepods and upper bodywork.
Unlike some of its main rivals, according to our information, Ferrari has decided not to radically change the aerodynamic concept of its sidepods.

McLaren and Mercedes, the latter in particular, have recently made significant changes to their concepts with their latest upgrades, substantially modifying the shapes and the way airflow travels along the sidepods. Neither team appears to have immediately achieved on track what it had seen in the windtunnel and CFD simulations.
Ferrari, on the other hand, has preferred to maintain greater continuity with the SF-26's current architecture.

It is understood to have worked mainly on optimising its existing solutions, without making fundamental changes to the bodywork. The main objective is believed to be reducing drag, as the SF-26 still suffers somewhat in this area. (Which is not helped by Ferrari's less-powerful engine.)

The team has therefore preferred a less invasive solution, seeking to maximise the potential of the current design while weighing up the performance gains against the resources needed to achieve them.

The new bodywork will be accompanied by modifications to the cooling louvres, adapting hot-air extraction to the new sidepod geometries. Further cooling configurations are planned for the following Mexican GP, where Ferrari is expected to introduce larger openings to cope with the particularly demanding conditions imposed by the altitude.
This does not mean that more radical alternatives have not been considered by Ferrari.
During development, numerous iterations were carried out in the windtunnel, exploring different geometries and bodywork concepts, also with the aerodynamic choices for the 2027 project in mind.

Among the solutions analysed at Maranello during the season was the sidepod design introduced by Red Bull, characterised by an interesting interpretation of the regulations concerning the floor body stays.

On the RB22, and on the Audi from Baku onwards, the structural stay connecting the floor to the bodywork is also exploited for aerodynamic purposes. Through the fillet between the stay and the sidepod surfaces, Red Bull has managed to define a particularly aggressive geometry, as the current regulations allow a fillet radius of 20mm. This has helped recreate the so-called waterslides, the channels that guide airflow towards the rear of the car.
This solution allows an element that is primarily structural to also influence the shape and aerodynamic behaviour of the bodywork.
Ferrari carefully examined and evaluated this concept, but decided not to devote a significant proportion of its resources to such a substantial transformation of the SF-26's sidepods.
The decision was mainly a matter of development priorities.

A substantial change to the sidepod philosophy would have required integration work with the rest of the aerodynamic platform, particularly the floor, without any certainty of obtaining a sufficiently significant advantage in the few remaining races.
At Maranello, the preference was therefore to concentrate efforts on another area, still considered to offer the greatest performance potential: the floor.
As for the new floor, the changes will not be limited to a single area, but will involve a more extensive revision of the entire system, from the front section through to the diffuser.
The decision to continue investing in this component is also linked to the results obtained with the previous package introduced at Zandvoort.

The development brought to the Netherlands followed Ferrari's failure to identify particularly significant opportunities for improvement in the short term, prompting the team to continue working on the floor geometry in search of a more substantial gain specifically for Austin.
The SF-26 has shown a good underlying design throughout the season, but the engineers have continued to seek an increase in the performance generated by the underside of the car.

The new Austin floor has been developed not only with the aim of increasing downforce, but also of addressing the aerodynamic balance, which is still too heavily biased towards the front, and widening the operating window, as Red Bull has somewhat managed to do.

The US GP will be the final event at which Ferrari introduces an aerodynamic package of this significance. After Austin, development of the SF-26 will be mainly limited to circuit-specific adaptations.

Ferrari has also used the numerous windtunnel iterations to explore different design directions for 2027, when the new car will feature substantially different aerodynamic solutions compared to the SF-26.

The future Ferrari will nevertheless retain some elements of continuity with the current project, particularly regarding the chassis, which has been one of the most convincing aspects of the 2026 car, while work on the 2027 power unit continues in parallel.
Austin will also provide an opportunity to verify the correlation between the results obtained from development tools and the car's behaviour on track.
keyPointsZh: 这是SF-26计划中最后一次如此规模的开发包，马拉内罗的注意力已基本转向明年赛车

items.summaryEn:
Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. 
I also feel I need to speak up about the hate and harassment Chris has received after the race. Everyone can have their opinions about what happened on track, but these personal attacks are not okay. Chris had a really strong stint and mistakes can happen. 
There’s no place for this kind of abuse in our sport or anywhere else.
detailZh:
兴奋的周末！很高兴驾驶我们的GT3赛车在波尔蒂芒参赛。有起有落，但作为团队，我们学到很多。
我也觉得有必要站出来谈谈克里斯在赛后所受到的仇恨和骚扰。每个人都可以对赛道上发生的事情有自己的看法，但这些个人攻击是不恰当的。
克里斯的表现非常出色，错误是会发生的。
在我们的运动或任何地方都不应该有这种虐待行为。
detailEn:
Exciting weekend! Was very happy to be racing our GT3 car in Portimão. There were some ups and downs, but as a team we learnt a lot. 
I also feel I need to speak up about the hate and harassment Chris has received after the race. Everyone can have their opinions about what happened on track, but these personal attacks are not okay. Chris had a really strong stint and mistakes can happen. 
There’s no place for this kind of abuse in our sport or anywhere else.
